title: OpenHands Agent Canvas 作例・解説動画
message: 自動化の設定を、持ち運ぶ前に点検する
operation: 架空の自動化の設定を、原典の serializeAutomation で .automation.json に書き出す
schedule の無い cron の入力（O03）が、原典の parseAutomationFile で止まる
原典の誤りの文から、足りない項目を読む
schedule だけを足した別の入力（O04）を別に読み込み、形が通ったファイルを保存する
形が通っても cron の書き方は確かめていないこと（O06）と、参照先は先頭の1件だけが入ること（O07）を読む
閲覧ページで設定を選び、理由を読み、実ファイルを保存する
audience: Agent Canvas の自動化を別の環境へ持ち運びたい日本語の開発者・.automation.json の形と読み込み検査の範囲を先に知りたい人
next_action: 作例ページ（../index.html#O03）で O03 と O04 を行き来し、原典の誤りの行と O06・O07 の注意を読み、形が通った .automation.json を保存する

output.orientation: landscape only; on phones the whole 16:9 canvas is scaled down by CSS. No portrait or square composition is authored or claimed.

authorship.film_code_and_japanese_copy: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote index.html, video.css, video.js, storyboard.json and README.md in this folder. This authoring step is separate from the runtime: no model ran inside the original API calls or the checks, and the film draws only saved values.
authorship.inputs: input/automation-settings.json (fictional O01–O08 automation settings, all repositories on example.invalid) and input/expected.json were fixed by the Studio Yebisu production side before execution.
authorship.execution: The production side ran run.mjs with Node v24.18.0 (TypeScript strip, no npm install, no network). Values in the record were returned by the unmodified OpenHands functions serializeAutomation, getAutomationExportFilename, parseAutomationFile, AutomationFileValidationError, hasAutomationInterface and getImportExportSpec with the genuine admitted @openhands/extensions 0.30.0 interface manifest — not by a model.
authorship.screenshots: video/assets/phone.jpg and desktop.jpg are unedited native in-app Chromium JPEG screenshots of the Studio Yebisu viewer page, captured by the production side (screens.json).

manifest.rule: video.js hashes the manifest bytes first, then requires its format, source_commit and the eight path/sha256/bytes entries to equal the values frozen in video.js before using anything else.

files.role: public actual run record: pinned upstream and 41 vendor hashes, eight inputs, written portable files, file names, parsed and re-parsed specs, original errors, observations, comparison with the pre-run expectation, 107 runner checks
155 independent production-side Python checks: full vendor bytes against Git blobs and the locked npm archive, eight exact inputs, projections and actual errors, six portable artifacts
separate copied source, fresh Node process and new private output directory reproduced the entire record and all six portable files byte-identically (same machine and tool versions)
frozen fictional input; every record input must equal it; every URL must be on example.invalid
pinned upstream OpenHands/OpenHands e4775b4 (1.27.1, MIT), 12 original files with Git blobs and 29 @openhands/extensions 0.30.0 files with npm members

screenshot provenance: phone O03 375×812 JPEG (rgb_sha256 b822a46d875b323ac3a8dbb2441daaf4a0b0973feaf1fbbe27d4fd4f303992cf), desktop O07 1265×889 JPEG (rgb_sha256 05183ebb3dba96d3b54c5e1d25e145ee46b6a277e309f6e7ac5e90f2b9692091)
viewer at a phone width: O03 stopped, the original error line with its Japanese reading, and the link to the O04 re-check
viewer at a desktop width: O07 accepted file shape and the first-repository-only caveat

sources.fetch_rule: Same-origin fetch of assets/<name> relative to document.baseURI with response.ok required. Missing file, HTTP error, invalid UTF-8 or JSON, byte length or SHA-256 mismatch, a different pinned commit/version/license, vendor lock, dependency integrity, runtime, API list, file envelope, input, per-case outcome, count, the O03 error text, the O03→O04 difference, the O05 issue count, the O06 schedule, the O07 repositories, the O08 literal text, the six rebuilt portable-file hashes, independent or reproduction check, screenshot provenance, JPEG start/end markers, JPEG header size or decoded dimensions rejects window.motionReady. No embedded fallback; the screenshots' RGB hashes are carried as provenance and are not recomputed in the browser because JPEG decoders may differ.

scope.shown: Real unmodified OpenHands Agent Canvas portable-automation-file functions on eight fictional settings: input settings → portable file → original file-shape validation → raw error → separate corrected input → actual .automation.json; and the Studio Yebisu viewer page that reads the saved record.
not_shown_or_claimed: the Agent Canvas app or server, agent or model execution
scheduled-task registration, a scheduler, webhook delivery, repository clone, OpenHands Cloud
six working automations: 6 is the number of files whose shape the original parser accepted
cron grammar or run times: O06 'not-a-cron' was accepted because the parser only requires a non-empty string
automatic or AI repair: O04 is a separate parser call on an input fixed before execution, differing from O03 only by spec.trigger.schedule
a lossless backup of multi-repository settings: O07 keeps only the first repository
security or sanitization from O08 keeping literal text
a new OS, other fonts or other tools (reproduction was on the same machine)
continuous screen recording (this is an edited code film), simulated chat, terminal or run animation
scope.excluded_from_screen: No fake terminal, chat, progress or invented UI; no full hashes on film (they are listed in the editor's #asset-list and here); English paths and errors only as smaller supplemental lines; full details remain in the viewer.

palette.amber: #a85f00 (caution: missing field, unchecked cron, dropped repository)

design.fonts: Local system fonts only: Yu Mincho / Hiragino Mincho for headlines, Yu Gothic UI / Hiragino Sans for Japanese text, Consolas / Menlo for JSON, paths and the original error. No downloads.

type_scale_px_at_1280.headlines: 60–72, one or two lines, at most 10 Japanese characters per line; never drawn below 56

design.phone_reading: At a 360px viewport the canvas is about 328px wide (scale ≈ 0.256): headlines ≈ 15–18px, counts ≈ 25px. JSON lines, paths, the English error and captions are supplemental at that width; the viewer keeps the full text.
design.labels: The scene 2 map is captioned 説明図 and states it is not the Agent Canvas screen; it uses only the actual O03 input fields and the missing path from the O03→O04 difference. Screenshots are captioned 閲覧ページの実画面 and drawn whole (contain) from the verified bytes, scaled only.
persistent: 5px plum top bar (as in the viewer); masthead: OpenHands Agent Canvas <version from record> ・ 自動化ファイルの入出力; step rail 入力 / 理由 / 再点検 / 注意 / 保存 with the current step underlined
footer: 架空の設定 ・ 原典APIの保存記録と閲覧ページの実画面 ・ 無音; OpenHands/OpenHands e4775b4
design.motion: Ease-out fades and short rises computed from absolute time; one check line sweeping the O01 file card; a dashed outline for the missing schedule; a lime highlight on the added schedule; a stroke-through on the dropped O07 repository. Scenes dip to paper over 0.35 s between them.

contract.canvas: getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); backing store equals renderConfig width × height; layout authored at 1280×720 and scaled; CSS scales the whole 16:9 canvas in the editor
contract.seek: window.seek(seconds) clamps to 0..28, records it as the selected time and returns a Promise that resolves after the requested frame is drawn from absolute time and the verified assets only; no frame depends on earlier frames, wall clock or randomness
contract.ready: window.motionReady resolves after the manifest and the eight files match SHA-256 and byte length, all record invariants pass, the six portable files rebuilt from the record match their file_sha256, both original JPEGs match their markers, header size and decoded dimensions, and local fonts are loaded; otherwise it rejects with the concrete reason, the canvas is cleared and hidden, controls are disabled and #retry re-fetches everything (one load at a time)
contract.export_mode: window.__MOTION_RENDER__ === true: editor chrome hidden, canvas only at exact size, no requestAnimationFrame preview
contract.preview: Starts paused at 0, no autoplay. #play toggles 再生/一時停止 (aria-pressed); #time (range 0–28 step 0.1) seeks; #reset returns to the last selected time (a seek to 14 stays at 14); scene buttons seek to a reading moment; #time-label shows the current time and state; after a successful retry the editor is stopped at the last selected time; #editor[data-state] is loading, ready or error; #editor-status says what was checked
